items.title: UPST Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Macro Risks and Revised Outlook
items.summary: Upstart Holdings exceeded Q3 earnings and revenue estimates with strong fee revenue growth of 41% and record contribution profit. However, the company lowered its 2026 revenue guidance to $1.35 billion from $1.4 billion due to deteriorating consumer credit conditions and higher funding costs. The company's secured lending business turned profitable with a 17% contribution margin, and management plans to launch Upstart Bank in early 2027 with $404.1 million in capital.
